rule.name: SpringTypedResponse
rule.message: Return a record or a specific type from this handler, never Object, JsonNode, Map<String, Object>, ResponseEntity<?>, a list or Optional of those, or null. For no body return void or ResponseEntity<Void>, and for an error throw an exception that a @RestControllerAdvice maps to a ProblemDetail.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $leaf := function($type) { exists($type[self::ClassType[pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Object') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode') or pmd-java:typeIs('tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode')] or self::WildcardType[not(*) or ClassType[pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Object')]] or self::ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')] [not(TypeArguments) or TypeArguments/*[2][self::WildcardType[not(*) or ClassType[pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Object')]] or self::ClassType[pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Object')]]]]) }, $inner := function($type) { $type[self::ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]]/TypeArguments/*[2] | $type[self::ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Optional') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.http.HttpEntity') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.reactivestreams.Publisher')]]/TypeArguments/* }, $untyped := function($type) { $leaf($type) or exists($type[self::ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.http.HttpEntity')][not(TypeArguments)]]) or (some $argument in $inner($type) satisfies ($leaf($argument) or (some $nested in $inner($argument) satisfies $leaf($nested)))) } return //MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler')]] /ClassType[$untyped(.)] | //ReturnStatement[NullLiteral] [ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::LambdaExpression][1][self::MethodDeclaration][ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping') or
